services.description: Core persistent storage layer (SQL + blob) used by Identity, Config and Messaging.
recovery_actions: Verify storage account replication status
Check for throttling on SQL elastic pool
Confirm blob service is accessible from all stamps

services.description: Authentication and token-issuance service. Hard dependency for API and Gateway.
recovery_actions: Restart identity service pods
Verify token-signing certificate is valid and not expired
Check OIDC well-known endpoint reachability
Drain and refresh identity cache

services.description: Centralized configuration provider. Must be healthy before API starts.
recovery_actions: Validate config store schema migration state
Force config cache invalidation
Restart config service with --bootstrap flag if needed

services.description: Async event bus (Service Bus-backed). Soft dependency for API, hard for Worker.
recovery_actions: Verify Service Bus namespace is accessible
Check for message lock contention on control-plane topics
Replay dead-letter messages after root cause is resolved

services.description: Main control-plane HTTP API. Depends hard on Identity and Config; soft on Messaging.
recovery_actions: Perform rolling restart of API pods
Verify config hot-reload succeeded
Confirm auth middleware initialized successfully
Run smoke test against /health and /readiness endpoints

services.description: Background worker processing async tasks from the Messaging bus.
recovery_actions: Scale worker deployment to zero and back to desired replica count
Verify dead-letter queues are drained or re-queued
Check distributed-lock state in Redis/Cosmos

services.description: Edge gateway / API Management layer routing external traffic to ControlPlane.API.
recovery_actions: Flush APIM cache
Re-validate backend health-check probe configuration
Force policy reload
